entities.summary: Alda Teodorani is an Italian writer. She has been defined as the "queen of Italian dark". The director Dario Argento has said "Alda Teodorani's stories are like my deepest nightmares." She made her debut in 1990 with the publication of Non hai capito in the Nero Italiano 27 racconti metropolitani anthology.
